title: Hubitat Event Status Mix
dataSources: Home Assistant state/logbook events (`homeassistant:event`), Homey flow/insights (`homey:flow`), SmartThings events (`smartthings:event`), Hubitat/openHAB logs, Node-RED flow events (`nodered:event`).
app: Home Assistant / Homey / SmartThings / Hubitat / openHAB event streams via MQTT, webhooks, and REST — forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=hubitat:event
| eval status_value=lower(coalesce(event_status,"unknown"))
| stats count as events by status_value
| sort - events
description: Breaks down the current mix of states reported by the Hubitat event feed.
value: A status-mix panel provides quick at-a-glance context before you investigate specific outliers.
implementation: Map the source's `event_status` values into a small set of clear labels and chart the resulting counts.
visualization: Donut or bar chart of event count by status.
grandmaExplanation: It predicts the overall mood of your Hubitat event feed by counting how many events are healthy, warning, or bad.
